tools.name: best_offer_for_url
tools.description: Find the best live coupon code or deal for any store or product link (e.g. https://www.nike.com/t/air-max) or bare domain (nike.com), including checkout pages. Returns the store and its single best offer, plus a few alternatives.

tools.name: get_store_offers
tools.description: All live coupon codes and deals for one store, best first. The store can be a name ("Nike"), a domain ("nike.com"), a URL, or a Papyras store slug. Each offer shows whether the network marked it verified and what shoppers reported.

tools.name: search_stores
tools.description: Search the stores that currently have live offers, by name or domain. Use it when the store name is unclear or to compare country versions of a store.

tools.name: top_offers_in_category
tools.description: The strongest live offers in a shopping category, one per store (e.g. "fashion", "electronics", "travel", "running shoes", "vpn", "pet food"). Category can be a name or slug.

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: Live offers for a theme or shopping event, one per store first: e.g. black-friday, cyber-monday, christmas-deals, free-shipping-codes, new-customer-discounts, buy-one-get-one, verified-codes, ending-soon, todays-best-deals.

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Details of one offer by its id (from an earlier result), including whether it is still live.

tools.name: report_code_result
tools.description: Tell Papyras Coupons whether a code or deal worked at checkout. Call it once for each offer the user (or you) actually tried, with worked true or false and, if it failed, a short reason. Reports are shown with the offer to the next shopper and help remove dead codes. Sends no personal data.
